commit.message:
feat(ui): Fluid sidebar with session status, done state, typography and theme pass (#166)

* feat(ui): add Tend's Graphite, Paper and Graphite Light themes

Port the Fluid Functionalism token set (surface ladder, shadow recipes,
hover/active overlays, type-scale roles, scroll fades) and Tend's four-colour
schemes. Each scheme mixes its surfaces from four base colours and points the
existing --basis-* tokens back at them, so the whole app carries the hue. The
Tend schemes also switch to Tend's typography (no positive tracking, 400 body).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): vendor the Fluid Functionalism components

Pull the radix flavours of the Fluid Functionalism components (button,
tooltip, dialog, dropdown, select, combobox, command menu, tabs, sidebar,
ask-user-questions, thinking indicator/steps, input-message and their shared
hooks and libs) into app-core, with Tend's dialog and command-menu edits.
scripts/vendor-fluid.mjs re-pulls them; the folder is excluded from lint and
format as third-party code.

The lockfile was resolved with pnpm 12, so it carries some unrelated
re-resolution churn; regenerate it with main's pnpm before merging.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): Fluid providers, Neutral themes and a theme palette

- Mount Fluid's motion, size and tooltip providers at the web and desktop
  roots, and put the app Tooltip on Fluid's tooltip (align is gone; Fluid
  anchors by side only).
- Connect screen, environment list and add-project dialog use Tend's
  borderless fields and Fluid's Button and Dialog.
- Swap Graphite for Tend's Neutral (dark and light) with its exact values;
  Paper stays mixed from its four base colours.
- Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a Fluid command palette that switches themes and stays
  open, the way Tend's palette tries colour schemes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(web): Fluid inset sidebar

The web shell now uses Fluid Functionalism's inset layout. The sidebar sits
on the canvas and the page is a raised card beside it, collapsed with the
topbar trigger or "[".

- Each project is a collapsible Fluid group with a hover "new agent" action.
  Sessions are menu rows with a provider icon, status loader, and hover
  rename and delete.
- A collapsed project shows a working loader on its label while any of its
  sessions are active; the old sidebar listed those sessions instead.
- Settings and States are footer rows next to the connection status.
- WorkspaceSidebar and the new FluidWorkspaceSidebar share one model hook.
  Desktop keeps the classic sidebar for now.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): default Fluid sidebar, no chat fades, slight chat edges

- Switch the web sidebar from inset to Fluid's default variant: the rail
  and the page share the canvas colour, split by a hairline.
- Drop the gradient fades at the top of the transcript and behind the
  composer.
- On the Tend themes the composer and user messages get a very slight edge
  mixed from the scheme (13% and 11% foreground).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): roomier sidebar without scroll fades

- The app's 14px root shrinks Fluid's rem-sized rows, so the sidebar runs
  on Fluid's default size step (rows 24.5px -> 28px) with 15px text.
- Drop Fluid's scroll fade and top/bottom hairlines on the sidebar list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): right-aligned user bubbles, #171717 Neutral, app tracking back

- User messages are a bubble sized to their text and held to the right
  (max 80%); assistant messages are unchanged.
- Neutral runs on #171717 with #363636 user bubbles and no bubble edge.
- The Tend themes keep the app's 0.01em letter spacing; Tend's zero
  tracking read cramped at 14px.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ui): keep the root font size fixed across UI fonts

The 14px body rule listed `html[data-ui-font='geist']` and
`html:not([data-ui-font])` without ` body`, so under Geist it set the root
to 14px while Inter kept 16px. Every rem followed the font: the chat column
(52rem) was 728px under Geist and 832px under Inter, and spacing shrank to
match. The rule and its `.font-normal` sibling now target body and
.font-normal for all three selectors.

With the root back at 16px, Fluid's compact rows are 28px on their own, so
the sidebar drops its size-ladder bump and keeps only its 15px text.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): fonts in the palette, narrower chat

- Ctrl/Cmd+K lists the UI fonts under Fonts; like themes, picking one
  leaves the palette open.
- The transcript and composer narrow from 52rem (832px) to 46rem (736px).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(ui): status sidebar with settled sessions, typography pass

Active cards plus a Settled shelf in the Fluid sidebar, backed by a
server-persisted session.settle (migration 12, settled_at). Also carries
the in-progress chat typography and Fluid component tweaks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(ui): one Fluid sidebar, Phosphor icons only, motion/react

The Fluid sidebar is now the only sidebar: desktop moves onto Fluid's
SidebarProvider (a titlebar drag strip above the header, Ctrl/Cmd+B kept)
and the old project-grouped view is deleted. FluidWorkspaceSidebar is
renamed WorkspaceSidebar/WorkspaceSidebarView; its session types move to
sidebar-sessions.ts. Tests that read the old sidebar's markup now read the
Fluid one, and app-core stubs ResizeObserver for jsdom.

lucide-react is gone: Fluid's icon map and the palette use Phosphor through
phosphorIcon(), which maps strokeWidth to weight. framer-motion imports are
now motion/react, and the vendor script rewrites them on re-pull.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sidebar): done state for unseen completions, status glyph and theme pass

Adds SessionSummary.doneAt (migration 13) set when a turn completes and
cleared by the new session.acknowledge command or the next turn start. The
sidebar shows done/working/needs-input/failed glyphs; recovery marks
abandoned turns as error. Also a command palette test, copy button on user
messages, and theme/typography tweaks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sidebar): refuse to settle live sessions, port web tests to the Fluid sidebar

A running or waiting session can no longer be settled: the environment and
mock return conflict and the card hides Settle, since nothing would bring it
back to Active once the turn finished. The vendor script refuses registry
targets outside the vendored directory. Web tests now target the Fluid
sidebar, and the web shell's page links regain their Primary nav landmark.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
